frozen_preconditions.macro_candidate: a nondegenerate cooccurring sign-aware pair (a,b) enumerated by all_or_pair_candidates
frozen_preconditions.state_cap: same original-N anchored frozen cap used by v3

definitions.B_x(G): generic raw upper bound R+p*q+q*U_plus+p*U_minus for pivot x in canonical state G

theorem.name: SEQUENTIAL_RAW_BUDGET_CERTIFICATE_GUARANTEES_FROZEN_V3_PLAN
theorem.statement: Suppose M fits cap. If there exist distinct x,y in V0 such that B_x(M)<=cap, exact elimination yields M_x with y still live, and B_y(M_x)<=cap, then frozen v3 has an exact admissible two-elimination macro plan for that candidate/order and the final root-free progress potential is strictly lower than before.
proof: By the generic raw elimination budget lemma, B_x(M)<=cap guarantees eliminate_var_capped(M,x,cap) cannot abort on the pre-subsumption raw accumulator. Its exact canonical output M_x is therefore defined and independently replayable.
The hypothesis y in vars_of(M_x) matches the frozen v3 requirement that the second distinct pre-macro pivot remain live after the first elimination.
Applying the same generic lemma to M_x gives that B_y(M_x)<=cap guarantees the second exact elimination and defines M_xy under the same original-N anchored cap.

Both x and y are distinct members of V0 and exact variable elimination removes them from the final state. The macro introduces at most one fresh variable e and no other fresh semantic variable. Therefore vars(M_xy) is a subset of (V0 minus {x,y}) union {e}, so |vars(M_xy)|<=|V0|-1.
In root-free mode the frozen v3 progress Phi equals live-variable count. Hence Phi(M_xy)<Phi(F).

The frozen v3 discovery loop deterministically enumerates all cooccurring macro pairs and all ordered pairs of distinct variables from V0. For this candidate/order, its own exact capped elimination calls succeed and its replay/progress gates pass; therefore the plan will be encountered and admitted without heuristic promotion.

relationship_to_previous_corridors.closed_pair: special case with zero external incidence; sequential bounds are trivially safe when macro fits cap
relationship_to_previous_corridors.aligned_one_sided: special case where each elimination has no external-by-external opposite-sign product and the robust raw bound stays <= its input macro/intermediate size
relationship_to_previous_corridors.mixed_sign: now admitted whenever the actual canonical post-macro bucket statistics satisfy the two sequential generic inequalities; mixed signs are no longer categorically outside a proved corridor

discovery_cost_boundary.note: This theorem is a sufficiency statement for an already frozen candidate/order. The frozen v3 enumerator remains finite and deterministic; no semantic oracle or heuristic ranking is introduced.
discovery_cost_boundary.important: A proof that some candidate/order always satisfies these inequalities for every reachable root-free nonterminal state is NOT supplied here.

remaining_open_gap.name: ALL_CANDIDATE_SEQUENTIAL_BUDGET_FAILURE
remaining_open_gap.definition: A genuine residual v3 availability witness must survive the earlier exact lanes and, for every cap-admissible B2 macro candidate and every ordered distinct old-pivot pair compatible with the frozen search, fail at least one of: first generic raw budget certificate, second-pivot liveness, second generic raw budget certificate, extension budget, exact replay, or strict-progress gate.
remaining_open_gap.sharpening: For the exact B2/frozen-v3 setting, replay and strict progress are structurally controlled once both eliminations exist on two distinct old pivots; the main quantitative frontier is therefore universal existence of a macro/order with both sequential raw budgets under cap, plus extension availability.

next_exact_target: Derive aggregate incidence/pressure conditions forcing at least one cap-admissible macro and ordered old-pivot pair to satisfy both sequential raw-budget inequalities, or construct a minimal reachable root-free counterexample in ALL_CANDIDATE_SEQUENTIAL_BUDGET_FAILURE.
